topic: The Universal Dilemma
text: The narrative begins as King Dhritarashtra asks for an account of the battle. You, Arjuna, asked Me to place your chariot between the two armies, but upon seeing your kin, you were paralyzed by sorrow, spoke of the evils of war, and sat down on the back seat of the chariot with a mind overwhelmed.

topic: The spirit is eternal, body is transitory
text: Understand that the invisible Spirit is eternal, while the physical body and visible world are but transitory; this is the truth seen by the seers. The Spirit pervading this universe is indestructible and cannot be slain.

topic: Death and Reincarnation of the soul
text: Just as a person discards old garments for new ones, the living entity acquires new bodies after casting away the old. The Spirit is eternal, all-pervading, and unchanging—it cannot be cut by weapons or burned by fire.

topic: Duty of a warrior
text: Considering your duty, do not waver, for there is nothing more auspicious for a warrior than a righteous war against evil. To refuse this duty is to incur sin and lose your reputation.

topic: Importance of Karma-yoga, the selfless action
text: I impart to you the wisdom of Karma-yoga; by this, you shall be freed from the bondage of your actions. In this path, no effort is lost, and even a little practice protects you from the great fear of birth and death.

topic: Material and spiritual aspects of life
text: Do not be like the misguided who delight in rituals for heavenly enjoyment; their minds are dominated by material desires. Rise above the three modes of nature and the pairs of opposites to be Self-conscious.

topic: Theory and practice of Karma-yoga
text: You have control over your duty, but no claim over the results. Work to the best of your ability with a mind attached to Me, remaining calm in both success and failure—this calmness of mind is yoga.

topic: Marks of a Self-realized person
text: An enlightened person is one who is completely free from all desires of the mind and is satisfied with the Eternal Being alone. Such a sage is unperturbed by sorrow and does not crave pleasure.

topic: Dangers of unrestrained senses
text: Thinking of sense objects leads to attachment, then desire, and then anger. Anger leads to delusion, which destroys reasoning and causes one to fall from the right path.

topic: Peace through sense control and Self-knowledge
text: A disciplined person, free from likes and dislikes, attains tranquility. This superconscious state leads to peace, and even at the end of life, it allows one to attain Nirvana.

topic: Why one should serve others?
text: I have stated a twofold path: Self-knowledge for the contemplative and the path of unselfish work for others. No one can remain actionless, for nature drives all to act; but those who engage in selfless service are superior.

topic: The first commandment of the creator
text: The creator established that humans should prosper through selfless service. By helping each other—you and the celestial controllers—you shall attain the supreme goal.

topic: Leaders should set an example
text: Always perform your duty efficiently and without attachment, for the world follows the standard set by noble persons. Even I engage in action relentlessly to prevent the confusion and destruction of these worlds.

topic: All works are the works of Nature
text: All work is done by the energy and power of nature; only the deluded person assumes they are the doer. The wise, knowing this, do not become attached to work.

topic: Two stumbling blocks on the path
text: Likes and dislikes for sense objects are the two major stumbling blocks on your path of Self-realization. It is better to perform your own natural work, even if inferior, than unnatural work.

topic: Lust is the origin of sin
text: Lust, born of passion, is the great devil and the enemy that veils Self-knowledge. It sits in your senses, mind, and intellect, deluding you by covering the truth.

topic: How to control lust
text: By controlling your senses first, you must kill this mighty enemy that destroys Self-knowledge and Self-realization.

topic: Karma-yoga is an ancient law
text: I taught this eternal science to King Vivasvan in ancient times; though it was lost, I reveal it to you now because you are My sincere devotee and friend.

topic: The purpose of incarnation of God
text: Whenever righteousness declines and unrighteousness predominates, I manifest Myself to protect the good, transform the wicked, and establish world order.

topic: Path of worship and prayer
text: I fulfill the desires of people in accordance with the motive with which they worship Me. I created the four divisions of society based on aptitude and vocation.

topic: Attached, detached, and forbidden action
text: Understanding the true nature of action is difficult; one must know the difference between selfish, selfless, and forbidden action.

topic: A Karma-yogi is not subject to the Karmic laws
text: One who sees inaction in action and action in inaction is wise. Such a person, free from desires and attachment to the fruits of work, incurs no Karmic reaction.

topic: Different types of spiritual practices
text: Some perform worship, others study scriptures, and some practice breathing or yogic exercises; all who perform such selfless service are purified by their sacrifice.

topic: A superior spiritual practice
text: The acquisition of Self-knowledge is superior to any material gift, for all actions culminate in knowledge. Acquire this from a Self-realized guru through reverence and service.

topic: Spiritual knowledge is revealed to a Karma-yogi
text: The fire of Self-knowledge reduces all bonds of Karma to ashes. Having gained this knowledge, one attains supreme peace.

topic: Knowledge, Karma-yoga are needed for Nirvana
text: Work does not bind one whose doubts are destroyed by Self-knowledge; therefore, cut your doubts with the sword of knowledge and resort to Karma-yoga.

topic: The path of Self-knowledge
text: Both the path of Self-knowledge and selfless service lead to the supreme goal, but selfless service is superior.

topic: Both paths lead to the Supreme
text: The ignorant see these paths as different, but the wise know that mastering one brings the benefits of both. A Karma-yogi whose mind is pure and who sees the Eternal Being in all is not bound.

topic: A Karma-yogi works for God only
text: One who works as an offering to the Lord remains untouched by sin, like a lotus leaf that never gets wet. They perform actions only for self-purification.

topic: The path of Self-knowledge
text: Spiritual knowledge destroys ignorance and reveals the Supreme. Those whose minds are merged with the Source do not take birth again.

topic: Additional marks of an enlightened person
text: An enlightened person looks at all beings—a priest, an outcast, or an animal—with an equal eye. They find happiness with the Eternal Being within and attain Nirvana.

topic: Path of meditation and contemplation
text: A sage is liberated by renouncing material enjoyments, controlling the senses and mind through yogic techniques, and making salvation the primary goal.

topic: A Karma-yogi is also a renunciant
text: One who performs duty without seeking its fruit is both a renunciant and a Karma-yogi. No one becomes a yogi without renouncing selfish motives.

topic: A definition of yoga and yogi
text: Yogic perfection is reached when one has no desire for sensual pleasures or attachment to the fruits of work.

topic: Mind is both a friend and an enemy
text: Elevate yourself by your own mind; it is your friend when controlled, but an enemy when it is not.

topic: Techniques of meditation
text: Sit in solitude, fix your mind on God, and practice meditation in a clean spot with an erect spine for self-purification. Moderation in eating and sleeping is essential for this yoga.

topic: Who is a yogi?
text: A yogi with a tranquil mind and controlled desires enjoys the infinite bliss of contact with God. The best yogi regards every being as himself.

topic: Two methods to subdue the mind
text: Though the mind is restless, it can be subdued by constant spiritual practice and detachment.

topic: Destination of unsuccessful yogi
text: The unsuccessful yogi is reborn in a pious family, regains previous knowledge, and strives again for perfection.

topic: Who is the best yogi?
text: I consider the yogi-devotee who lovingly contemplates Me with supreme faith to be the best of all.

topic: Definitions of matter, consciousness, and spirit
text: My lower nature is eightfold material energy, but My higher nature is the Spirit by which this universe is sustained.

topic: The Supreme spirit is the basis of everything
text: Everything in the universe is strung on Me like jewels on a thread. I am the life in all living beings and the eternal seed of all creatures.

topic: Who seeks God?
text: Only those who surrender to Me can cross My divine illusive power (Maya). The four types who seek Me are the distressed, the seeker of knowledge, the seeker of wealth, and the enlightened.

topic: God can be seen in any image of worship
text: I make the faith steady in whoever desires to worship any deity with faith. The ignorant do not know My transcendental form and assume I take human form as they do.

topic: Definitions of supreme spirit, spirit, individual soul
text: The immutable Spirit is God; the power of God that causes manifestation is Karma. I am the Supersoul residing inside every cell as the supreme controller.

topic: Theory of reincarnation and Karma
text: One who remembers Me while leaving the body at death attains Me. Whatever object you remember at the end of life, that you shall achieve.

topic: A simple method of God-realization
text: Always remember Me and do your duty; you shall certainly attain Me if your mind and intellect are focused on Me.

topic: Attain salvation by meditating on God
text: By controlling the senses and meditating on Me while uttering OM, one attains the supreme abode.

topic: Everything in the creation is cyclic
text: A day of the creator lasts billions of years; beings emerge at day and merge back at night in a continuous cycle.

topic: Two basic paths of departure after death
text: There is a path of light leading to salvation and a path of darkness leading to rebirth.

topic: Spiritual knowledge leads to salvation
text: Knowing these paths, a yogi is not bewildered; be steadfast in your union with Me.

topic: Knowledge of the supreme is the biggest mystery
text: This Self-knowledge is the king of all knowledge and the most secret mystery. All beings depend on Me, yet I am independent of them.

topic: The theory of evolution and involution
text: I create the multitude of beings again and again through My material nature at the start of each cycle.

topic: Everything is a manifestation of God
text: I am the ritual, the sacrifice, the supporter, the father, and the mother of the universe. I am the sacred 'OM,' the goal, the refuge, and the immutable seed.

topic: Attaining salvation by devotional love
text: I personally take care of the material and spiritual welfare of those who always remember and adore Me.

topic: The Lord accepts and eats the offering of love
text: I accept even a leaf, a flower, or water if offered with devotion by a pure-hearted seeker.

topic: There is no unforgivable sinner
text: Even the most sinful, if they resolve to worship Me with single-minded devotion, must be regarded as a saint. Sincere repentance burns all sins.

topic: The path of devotional love is easier
text: Anyone who surrenders to My will with loving devotion can attain the supreme abode.

topic: God is the origin of everything
text: I am the origin of all celestial controllers and great sages. All diverse qualities in humans, from intelligence to fear, arise from Me.

topic: God gives spiritual knowledge to His devotees
text: I give knowledge to those who adore Me, and I destroy their darkness of ignorance with the lamp of spiritual knowledge.

topic: Everything is a manifestation of the Absolute
text: I am the Spirit abiding in the inner psyche of all beings; I am their beginning, middle, and end.

topic: A brief description of divine manifestations
text: Among mountains, I am the Himalaya; among words, I am the cosmic sound 'OM'; among warriors, I am Rama; and I am all-devouring death.

topic: Creation is a small part of the Absolute
text: Everything endowed with glory and power is a manifestation of but a small fraction of My splendor.

topic: The vision of God is the ultimate aim of a seeker
text: You asked to see My universal form, and I granted you the divine eye to behold My majestic power.

topic: Lord Krishna shows His cosmic form
text: I revealed My form containing the entire universe, blazing with the splendor of thousands of suns.

topic: Arjuna is frightened to see the Cosmic form
text: Seeing My mouths like the fires of dissolution, you were frightened. I am death, the mighty destroyer, come to destroy these warriors.

topic: We are only a divine instrument
text: These warriors are already destroyed by Me; get up and be My instrument to attain glory. All battles are Mine, and I do everything through your body.

topic: God can be seen by devotional love
text: I can be known in essence and reached only through single-minded devotion.

topic: Worship a personal or impersonal God?
text: While those who worship the unmanifest Absolute also attain Me, it is much more difficult for embodied beings.

topic: Reasons for worshipping a personal God
text: I swiftly become the savior of those who worship Me as a personal God and offer all actions to Me.

topic: The four paths to God
text: Focus on Me, or practice any discipline that suits you; even working as My instrument without selfish motives leads to perfection.

topic: Karma-yoga is the best Path
text: Renunciation of attachment to the fruits of work is better than meditation; peace follows such renunciation immediately.

topic: The attributes of a devotee
text: My dear devotee is friendly, compassionate, free from "I" and "my," and even-minded in pleasure and pain.

topic: The theory of creation
text: The physical body is the creation, and the one who knows it is the creator. Understanding both is true spiritual knowledge.

topic: The fourfold noble truth as means of Nirvana
text: Humility, nonviolence, honesty, and unswerving devotion to Me are the means of acquiring knowledge.

topic: A description of the supreme spirit, spirit, and jiva
text: Material nature and the Spiritual Being are both beginningless. The Spirit in the body is the witness and the Supreme Self.

topic: Attributes of the spirit
text: The eternal Supersoul, though dwelling in the body, does not do anything and is not tainted, just as space is not tainted by its subtlety.

topic: Beings are born from the union of spirit and matter
text: Material nature is the mother, and I am the life-giving father.

topic: How three modes of material nature bind us
text: Goodness, Passion, and Ignorance fetter the eternal soul to the body. Goodness attaches one to happiness; Passion to action; and Ignorance to laziness.

topic: Three modes are also the vehicles of transmigration
text: One who dies in goodness goes to heaven; in passion, they are reborn attached to action; in ignorance, they are reborn as lower creatures.

topic: Attain Nirvana after rising above three modes
text: When you perceive no doer other than these modes and know the Supreme beyond them, you attain salvation.

topic: Bonds of three modes can be cut by devotional love
text: One who serves Me with unswerving love rises above these modes and becomes fit for Nirvana.

topic: Creation is like a tree created by of Maya
text: This cosmos is like an eternal banyan tree with roots above and branches below.

topic: Cut the tree of attachment to attain salvation
text: Cut the roots of this tree—ego and desire—with the ax of Self-knowledge and detachment to reach the supreme abode.

topic: Spirit is the essence of everything
text: I am the light in the sun, the energy supporting all beings, and the digestive fire within you. I am seated in your inner psyche as memory and knowledge.

topic: Supreme spirit, spirit and the created beings
text: I am the Supreme Being who transcends both the temporal world and the eternal Spirit.

topic: A list of divine qualities to be cultivated
text: Cultivate the twenty-six divine virtues, like fearlessness, charity, and honesty, which lead to salvation.

topic: A list of demonic qualities to be given up
text: Hypocrisy, pride, and ignorance lead to bondage. Demons believe the world is without God or order and are born for its destruction.

topic: Lust, anger, and greed are the three gates to hell
text: These three are the gates of hell leading to bondage; you must give them up to attain the supreme abode.

topic: One must follow the scripture
text: Let scripture be your authority in determining what should be done.

topic: Three types of faith
text: Your faith is of three kinds: Goodness, passion, and ignorance. You are known by your faith and become whatever you contemplate with it.

topic: Three types of food
text: Food in goodness promotes health and joy; food in passion causes pain and disease; and food in ignorance is stale or impure.

topic: Austerity of thought, word, and deed
text: Austerity consists of purity and nonviolence in deeds, truthful and beneficial speech, and serenity of mind.

topic: Threefold name of God
text: 'OM TAT SAT' is the threefold name of God; all acts of sacrifice and charity should commence with 'OM'.

topic: Definition of renunciation and sacrifice
text: Renunciation is giving up work for personal profit; sacrifice is giving up attachment to the fruits of all work.

topic: Three types of sacrifice
text: Obligatory work performed as duty, renouncing attachment to the result, is sacrifice in the mode of goodness.

topic: Three types of spiritual knowledge
text: Knowledge in goodness sees a single immutable Reality in all beings.

topic: Attain salvation by duty, discipline, devotion
text: You can attain perfection by worshipping the Supreme Being through your natural duty.

topic: Karmic bondage and the free will
text: The Lord causes all beings to evolve like puppets mounted on a machine of Karma. Karma is the eternal justice from which there is no escape.

topic: Path of surrender is the ultimate path to God
text: Set aside all doership and attachment; just surrender to My Will. I shall liberate you from all sins. Do not grieve.

topic: Both spiritual knowledge and action are needed
text: Wherever the Lord of yoga and the weapons of duty are present, there will be prosperity, victory, and morality.
